name: Ecuador 6-Bus Reduced Planning Case
description: Reduced Ecuador planning case executed with the PARAMO formulation and calibrated hydrology.
public_scope_note: The public distribution includes corridor utilization, new circuits, transmission CAPEX, and fuel-resolved capacity, generation, additions, and CO2 emissions reconstructed from generator-level model output.
zone_code_convention: Public 6-bus files use canonical Ecuador DataHub zone codes; original model zone codes are retained in explicit ModelFromNode/ModelToNode and model_zone_code fields.

fuel_detail.method: Generator-level GeneratedPower, YearOperatingPlants, and BuildActivity results are classified using the source-fuel field in the 6-bus input trace. Residual and FuelOil are reported together as FUEL OIL; Gas and GasCC are reported as GAS; imports are identified by model class.
fuel_detail.validation: For every case and year, DIESEL + FUEL OIL + GAS reproduces the published FossilThermal aggregate within listing precision.
